_about: Dates worth planning content around, for the Moments desk. Seed data: add or correct through a PR. Golf majors checked against press listings on 2026-10-20 (Sky Sports, PGA Tour, Golf News Net). Springbok, Proteas and Sunshine Tour dates are deliberately not here: sources disagreed, so the live feed catches them instead. South African public holidays follow the Public Holidays Act (a Sunday holiday moves to the Monday).

events.title: Halloween
events.angle: Light and playful. Scary-score jokes work; keep it about golf, not costumes.

events.title: Black Friday
events.angle: Retail brands: plan offers from the stock list. Prepare the stories before the week, not on the day.

events.title: Day of Reconciliation (public holiday)
events.angle: A day off with friends and family: a group bay booking is an easy plan.

events.title: Christmas Day
events.angle: Gift ideas for golfers go out in the two weeks before, not on the day.

events.title: Day of Goodwill (public holiday)
events.angle: Family time and visitors in town: something to do out of the heat or rain.

events.title: New Year's Day
events.angle: Fresh starts and goals. Hold any campaign name until it is approved.

events.title: Valentine's Day
events.angle: A date idea that is not dinner. Two bays, one scorecard.

events.title: Human Rights Day (public holiday, observed Monday)
Good Friday (Easter long weekend)
events.angle: Four days off. Plans for the weekend and the kids.

events.title: The Masters
events.angle: The biggest golf conversation of the spring. Pressure putts, green jackets, a Sunday watch-party angle.

events.title: Mother's Day
events.angle: A gift or an outing that is not flowers.

events.title: PGA Championship
events.angle: Major week: react to the leaderboard, not the calendar.

events.title: Youth Day (public holiday)
events.angle: School holidays and a day off: kids and juniors.

events.title: Father's Day
events.angle: The biggest gift moment for golf retail. Plan from the stock list, post two weeks ahead.

events.title: The Open Championship (St Andrews)
events.angle: Major week at the home of golf.

events.title: Women's Day (public holiday)
events.angle: Celebrate the women who play. Real members, with permission.
